{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Freejack''''' was a modified [[IPV-1]] patrol craft that was captured from a planetary defense network by [[Frei Aycen]], during the time leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Refitting the ship to have additional cargo space, and removing several shield generators in order to make room and power available for a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], Aycen made sure the ship had room for 400 metric tons of cargo, and was armed with four light [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and a [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]].
